name: Rosy Champagne
text: Before bidding, two chosen hearts in your hand gain +2 rank.
prototypeNote: Before bidding, use Edit card to give the two chosen hearts +2 rank.
decision: Which two hearts to raise: the ones Unfolding Butterfly will lift further, or the ones you plan to pass to your partner.
opponent: Visible before bids; opponents bid knowing which cards grew.
aiNote: Raise the two highest hearts or diamonds below ace in your longer of the two suits.
rationale: A Red splash that makes the flood or chorus suit win its early contests, the answer both archetypes list to opponents holding the top cards; +2 on two cards keeps it close to Honed Edge's total value.
deviation: Narrowed from hearts or diamonds to hearts, so it serves one archetype.
